hero.title: One layer between your catalog and the AI that sells it.
hero.description: Whether people search Google, shop on Amazon or ask a chatbot, AI now answers with a product, and every assistant has its own rules for choosing it and buying it. ecentic is one layer between your catalog and those assistants. It fixes the data they read, gets your checkout ready for them to buy, and keeps up when their rules change.

items.question: What does ecentic do?
items.answer: ecentic is one layer between your catalog and the AI assistants that sell it. It simulates how ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini compare products, helps improve the data they read, and supports agent checkout on WooCommerce.

items.question: Which AI assistants does it cover?
items.answer: Store simulations run on ChatGPT, Claude and Gemini. Shopify visit tracking recognises supported AI referral signals, including ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini and Copilot. Checkout depends on your store setup and the shopping platform’s eligibility. Each AI channel page shows the current status.

items.question: Does ecentic change our store without asking?
items.answer: Listing changes require your chosen Apply action, which generates and publishes a title and description. Structured data and Merchant Center sync use separate controls. Connecting Shopify also installs the visit-tracking script. Importing product content does not rewrite it.

items.question: Does it work with our platform?
items.answer: Shopify and WooCommerce connect directly. Other platforms can import a supported XML or JSON product feed or a CSV. Feed support depends on the export structure and mapped fields; feed imports do not write back to the original platform.

items.question: Do you need access to our systems for a pilot?
items.answer: A pilot can start from an accessible public catalog or a supported product feed. We agree the scope with you before any system integration or store-write access is required.

items.question: How is our data handled?
items.answer: The security page describes current catalog access, tracking and AI-provider handling. Review our privacy policy and the providers used by the product, then confirm data processing, deployment and contracting requirements with us before a pilot.

items.question: Is this SEO?
items.answer: ecentic focuses on the product data and checkout that AI shopping assistants use to compare and buy. The work can overlap with structured-data and catalog quality practices, but its measurements are simulations, detected AI referrals and checkout checks, rather than search rankings.

items.question: What does it cost?
items.answer: The store check is free with an account. Single stores can choose a monthly plan or pay-as-you-go. The performance-fee attribution rules and limits are explained on Pricing; attribution does not prove incremental sales. Enterprise pilots are scoped with you.
